name: Work sample exercise brief
summary: For one approved role, the hiring manager gets a practical exercise: a bounded task from the role's real work, instructions for the candidate with a time limit and adjustments, and the evidence the panel will look for. The panel judges the work; nothing is rated here.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of recruiting work: the reader, trigger, inputs, output and decision for a practical exercise, and the method, rules, stop conditions, output format, tests and worked example written from how that work is done.
